strings.quality_value_tooltip:
Constant CQ/CRF quality

A lower value produces higher quality and a larger file.
A higher value reduces quality and file size.

NVIDIA uses CQ and CPU uses CRF.
The original profile uses 30.
strings.bitrate_tooltip:
Target bitrate

The average amount of data per second to target.

A higher value usually improves quality but increases file size.
In CBR mode it is maintained as a fixed bitrate.
strings.max_bitrate_tooltip:
Maximum bitrate

Limits bitrate peaks during VBR encoding.

It should be equal to or greater than the target bitrate.
It is only used with variable bitrate.
